problem:
In **ascending order,** the $x$-coordinates of the points where the hyperbola $6{x}^{2}-2{y}^{2}=100$ intersects the line $y=-x$ are

$\,x=$
{{field-1}}$\,$ and $\,x=$
{{field-2}}.
worked_solution:
To find the points where the hyperbola intersects the line $y=-x,$ we first replace $y$ with $-x$ in the equation of the hyperbola and solve for $x,$ as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}6{x}^{2}-2{y}^{2} & =100 \\ 6{x}^{2}-2(-x)^{2} & =100 \\ 6{x}^{2}-2{x}^{2} & =100 \\ 4{x}^{2} & =100 \\ {x}^{2} & =25 \\ x & =\pm 5\end{aligned}
$$

So, in ascending order, the $x$-coordinates of the points of intersection are
$x=-5$ and $x=5.$
